# Uncensored AI API or Model — RouterHub

> RouterHub is an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API gateway for Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, GLM and Qwen, including uncensored and abliterated variants where available. Pay per token, no subscription, crypto accepted.

## Key facts

- Primary keyword: uncensored AI API or model.
- Also covers: uncensored AI, uncensored AI model, abliterated models, unfiltered AI API.
- Compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs; works with Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode and Codex CLI.
- Billing: pay per token, no subscription; prompt caching; card and crypto.
- Model IDs and availability are listed in the RouterHub dashboard.
- Uncensored variants reduce refusals; they do not guarantee refusal-free output.
